items.title: Price increase takes effect
items.quote:
wir investieren weiter in den Ausbau unseres Glasfasernetzes. Deshalb erhöht sich der
monatliche Grundpreis Ihres Tarifs „Muster DSL 250“ ab dem 01.04.2026 von 39,99 € auf
44,99 €.
items.computation: The letter states the new price of 44,99 € applies from 01.04.2026, a fixed calendar date printed in the letter. No counting or shifting needed.

items.title: Special termination right (§ 57 TKG) deadline
items.quote:
Sie können Ihren Vertrag innerhalb von drei Monaten nach
Zugang dieser Mitteilung ohne Einhaltung einer Frist und ohne Kosten kündigen, frühestens
zum Zeitpunkt des Wirksamwerdens der Änderung (§ 57 TKG).
items.computation: The period is 3 months from 'Zugang' (actual receipt) of this notice, not from the document date, and NetzMuster GmbH is a private company so no statutory deemed-delivery rule (like the tax/administrative 3-4 day rule) applies. The actual arrival date is unknown; as the earliest plausible reading, receipt is assumed on the document date, Mon 16.02.2026 (day of the event not counted per § 187 Abs. 1 BGB). Three months later (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) falls on Sat 16.05.2026. Termination-notice periods are not extended to the next business day when the last day is a weekend/holiday (BGH III ZR 172/04), so the deadline itself remains Sat 16.05.2026 - meaning the cancellation must actually reach NetzMuster GmbH by Fri 15.05.2026 at the latest to be safe, and should be sent by roughly 08.05.2026 to allow for postal transit. If the letter in fact arrived later than 16.02.2026, the three-month window shifts correspondingly later.

warnings: The three-month special-termination deadline runs from the day the letter actually arrived ('Zugang'), which is not stated; the date above assumes arrival on the printed document date (16.02.2026) as the earliest plausible reading — if it arrived later, the deadline is correspondingly later, and practically the cancellation should reach NetzMuster GmbH a day or two before the calculated Saturday, i.e. by Fri 15.05.2026.

The IBAN printed (DE71 3705 0198 0001 2312 31) is NetzMuster GmbH's own account for the customer's information/payments to them, not a request to send money elsewhere; it checks out structurally but ownership cannot be verified from the letter alone.
